Weekly Recipe Card Meal Planner

Drag recipes from your library into any meal slot.

Drag a card onto Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, or Other — or tap + Add on a meal and then tap a card. Click the ↗ button to view the full recipe card.
Cards are uploaded to the server, so they appear on every device.
Tip: You can use the same recipe on more than one day.
